{{Top|leg}}
'''Station 321''' was an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] industrial facility located in the same [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] as [[Quekka Trench Station]]. Following the decimation of the [[Quekka fish]] population due to [[Poison/Legends|toxins]], [[Rendeel Industries]], Quekka Trench Station was shut down until such a time as it would once more be profitable to run the station. Station 321 was subsequently abandoned at the same time.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
